title: AI Transformation Analyst, Talent & Culture
summary: Find, build and roll out AI tools that make Talent & Culture and Communications teams faster and better, locally and across the group.
responsibilities: Identify and prioritise AI use cases with business stakeholders
Build GenAI assistants and automations with the engineering team
Drive adoption through training and communities of practice
Track impact and make sure tools meet data-privacy and responsible-AI standards

title: Credit Analyst, Venture & Growth Lending
summary: Analyse and structure debt financing for high-growth companies and venture capital funds.
responsibilities: Analyse company financials, business models and cash runway
Build financial models and propose loan structures and covenants
Prepare credit papers for the risk committee
Monitor the performance of the loan portfolio

title: Marketing Data Analyst

responsibilities: Build dashboards for campaign and channel performance
Query and combine data from CRM and web analytics
Present findings and recommendations to the marketing team

title: KYC / AML Team Lead
summary: Lead a team that onboards and reviews corporate clients in line with financial crime rules.
responsibilities: Lead and develop a team of KYC analysts
Own quality of onboarding and periodic reviews
Improve processes and work with Compliance on escalations

title: Internal Communications Manager
summary: Keep CIB employees informed and engaged, especially through change.
responsibilities: Plan and write internal communications and leadership messages
Support change programmes with clear communication
Run the intranet and all-staff channels

title: Learning & Development Partner
summary: Design learning that helps CIB employees build the skills the business needs, including AI skills.
responsibilities: Design and run learning programmes and workshops
Work with business leaders to identify skill gaps
Measure the impact of learning
